steps.text: BUG-31a [BP], the real-time half: each load is timed on real frame times from the click (SceneTransit's start mark) to the shutter off, with nothing recording (a capture's cost would be timed). load.<name>.frames: no real frame over 250 ms; load.<name>.time: the office shown (the shutter starting up) within 1.0 s of the click. The first load is the session's cold one (seals and daters painted for the first time). flow_load_seq captures the same loads for 'frozen' and 'cuts'
